hard.direct_flight_preference: Very important to Carissa, flexible for Niki
hard.climate: Not too hot — mild summer temps preferred (60-78°F)

preferences.food_priorities: Sushi/omakase, seafood, dim sum, great restaurants — the usual family standards
preferences.vibe_priorities: Elevated greenery, aesthetic spots, water/coasts, teen shopping, vintage bars

why: Best foodie match: world-class omakase (Sushi Kashiba, Taneda — $65-250/pp), excellent dim sum scene in International District (Jade Garden, Dim Sum King), incredible seafood (The Walrus and the Carpenter for oysters, Ray's Boathouse with mountain views)
Mild summer temps — Seattle summers are perfect, rarely above 78°F
Mountains AND water — Puget Sound, Olympic Mountains visible, Mt. Rainier day trips (Carissa's mountains + Niki's water)
Pike Place Market is the aesthetic-foodie dream. Chihuly Garden is elevated art-greenery.
Downtown shopping for Ashi (University Village, Pacific Place, Bellevue Square has Brandy Melville)
Great coffee culture — original Starbucks, tons of Blue Bottle-tier indie shops
Boba scene is strong (Ashi)
Drinks with views — many waterfront spots with mountain backdrops
watch_out: Direct flight is ~5 hours — longer than East Coast options
Omakase spots book out fast — need to reserve early
Can feel gray some days even in summer (but mostly sunny July-Aug)

family_match.niki: Clear water at San Juan Islands day trip, incredible seafood, great coffee
family_match.carissa: Mountains everywhere, vintage bars in Capitol Hill and Ballard, fried rice at dim sum

Shopping paradise for Ashi — Oxford Street, Carnaby Street, Brandy Melville on Regent Street, vintage stores in Brick Lane
Borough Market = SF Ferry Building energy but bigger. Aesthetic food halls.
Vintage/atmospheric bars everywhere for Carissa — speakeasies, wood-paneled pubs
Great seafood (oyster bars, fish markets), amazing steak spots for Ashi
Blue Bottle has London locations; tons of specialty coffee

7+ hour flight (but direct, overnight both ways)
No beach/clear blue water for Niki (could day-trip to Brighton or Cornwall)

options.airline: BA direct PIT→London, then Vueling/easyJet to Bilbao (1hr drive to San Sebastián)
why: Best-of-both-worlds trip: London's parks/shopping/omakase + world's best pintxos city
San Sebastián is THE foodie destination — pintxos bar-hopping in Old Town is exactly the optimized hidden-gem-hunting this family loves
La Concha beach — gorgeous crescent bay, clear-ish water, mountains behind (everyone wins)
Mild summer weather in both cities
Could split 4 days London + 3 days San Sebastián
San Sebastián is compact, walkable, beautiful — very aesthetic
watch_out: Requires a connection/second flight (but it's a short 2hr hop from London)
More complex logistics than a single-city trip
San Sebastián teen shopping is limited (but London covers that)
Two currencies, two languages
